CRA Fund column: Other 77,041 (printed 77,041). Schedule 535,535 + 209,649 + 77,041 = 822,225 vs statement 822,226 (difference 1 = the printed Total-column Other 92,233 vs columns 14,471 + 720 + 77,041 = 92,232, a rounding difference in the report itself).
